form.label: gNMI Operation
form.description: Is gnmic connected, which subscriptions stream, and why a target fails.

div.h2: How gnmic works and how it reports failures
div.p: For every target, gnmic opens one gRPC channel (TLS unless insecure is true), sends the username and password as gRPC metadata, and starts one gNMI Subscribe RPC per subscription. The device then streams updates. When a channel or an RPC fails, gnmic logs the error and tries again after the retry timer (30s in this lab). It keeps running while the device is down.
The dashboard starts at the last 15 minutes so a corrected configuration is not obscured by old errors. Select a longer time range when investigating the earlier history.

ul.li: Runtime log (index gnmi_ops, sourcetype gnmi:runtime). gnmic writes JSON lines with level, msg, target, subscription, and err. A connection problem appears as level=ERROR msg="subscription receive error". The err text holds the gRPC status code, for example code = Unavailable … dial tcp 10.0.0.1:9339: i/o timeout. This app adds grpc_code and a plain failure_cause.

Target metrics (index gnmi_metrics). gnmic_target_up is 1 when the gNMI connection is established. gnmic_target_connection_state is the gRPC channel state: 0 UNKNOWN, 1 IDLE, 2 CONNECTING, 3 READY, 4 TRANSIENT_FAILURE, 5 SHUTDOWN.

Subscribe counters. gnmic_subscribe_number_of_failed_subscribe_request_messages_total counts Subscribe RPCs that could not start. gnmic_subscribe_number_of_received_subscribe_response_messages_total counts updates received. That counter only exists once data flows, so a missing counter also means no data.

div.p: The collector scrapes those metrics from gnmic's local API at 127.0.0.1:7890/metrics. It also scrapes its own counters from 127.0.0.1:8888, so failed sends to HEC are visible too.

tr.td: No answer on the gNMI port
IP address, routing, ACL or firewall between the collector and the device
The device answers, but nothing listens on that port
gNMI is not enabled, or the port is wrong (see Devices)
first record does not look like a TLS handshake, x509, certificate
TLS settings differ between gnmic and the device
The insecure and skip-verify settings on the gNMI page, and the device certificate
Login rejected or the user lacks gNMI rights
Username, password, AAA authorization on the device
The device refuses this path, mode, or encoding
Only that subscription fails. Remove the path or use one the device supports

ol.li: Port reachable: timeout 3 bash -c 'echo >/dev/tcp/DEVICE/PORT' && echo open
gNMI, TLS, and login in one call: gnmic -a DEVICE:PORT -u USER --skip-verify capabilities. Use --insecure for a device without TLS. gnmic asks for the password when -p is left out.
One read: gnmic -a DEVICE:PORT -u USER --skip-verify get --path /system/state
Add --debug to print each RPC and the gRPC channel state changes.
Running state of this gnmic: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7890/api/v1/targets. Passwords appear as ****.
Raw counters: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:7890/metrics | grep gnmic_

div.p: Docs: global flags (log, debug, timeout, retry), capabilities, get, targets, subscriptions, API server and metrics.

search.query: | mstats latest(_value) AS up WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="gnmic_target_up" BY name | stats sum(up) AS connected count AS total | eval connected=coalesce(connected, 0), value=connected." of ".coalesce(total, 0) | fields value
| mstats latest(_value) AS state WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="gnmic_target_connection_state" BY name | where state!=3 | stats count

| mstats max(_value) AS hi min(_value) AS lo WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="gnmic_subscribe_number_of_received_subscribe_response_messages*" BY extracted_source subscription | eval received=hi-lo | stats sum(received) AS received | eval received=coalesce(received, 0)

| mstats max(_value) AS hi min(_value) AS lo WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="otelcol_exporter_send_failed*" BY metric_name exporter | eval failed=hi-lo | stats sum(failed) AS failed | eval failed=coalesce(failed, 0)

| mstats latest(_value) AS value WHERE index="$metrics_index$" (metric_name="gnmic_target_up" OR metric_name="gnmic_target_connection_state") BY name metric_name | eval metric=if(metric_name="gnmic_target_up", "up", "state") | xyseries name metric value | join type=left name [ search index="$ops_index$" sourcetype="$runtime_sourcetype$" level=ERROR | stats latest(_time) AS last_error latest(failure_cause) AS last_cause latest(grpc_code) AS grpc_code BY target | rename target AS name ] | eval status=if(up=1, "connected", "not connected"), channel=case(state=0, "UNKNOWN", state=1, "IDLE", state=2, "CONNECTING", state=3, "READY", state=4, "TRANSIENT_FAILURE (gnmic retries)", state=5, "SHUTDOWN"), last_error=strftime(last_error, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table name status channel last_error grpc_code last_cause

panel.title: gRPC channel state per target (3 = READY, 4 = TRANSIENT_FAILURE)

search.query: | mstats max(_value) AS state WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="gnmic_target_connection_state" span=1m BY name | xyseries _time name state
index="$ops_index$" sourcetype="$runtime_sourcetype$" level=ERROR | timechart span=1m count BY failure_cause

| mstats latest(_value) AS value WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="gnmic_subscribe_number_of_*" BY metric_name extracted_source subscription | eval counter=case(like(metric_name, "%failed_subscribe_request%"), "failed_starts", like(metric_name, "%received_subscribe_response%"), "updates_received", true(), metric_name), key=extracted_source." / ".subscription | xyseries key counter value | eval updates_received=coalesce(updates_received, 0), failed_starts=coalesce(failed_starts, 0), health=case(updates_received>0, "streaming", failed_starts>0, "not started: see errors", true(), "waiting") | rename key AS "target / subscription" | table "target / subscription" health updates_received failed_starts

| mstats max(_value) AS hi min(_value) AS lo WHERE index="$metrics_index$" metric_name="otelcol_exporter_*" BY metric_name exporter | eval count=hi-lo, kind=case(like(metric_name, "%send_failed%"), "failed", like(metric_name, "%sent%"), "sent", true(), null()) | where isnotnull(kind) | eval signal=case(like(metric_name, "%metric_points%"), "metric points", like(metric_name, "%log_records%"), "log records", true(), "other"), row=exporter." (".signal.")" | xyseries row kind count | eval sent=coalesce(sent, 0), failed=coalesce(failed, 0) | rename row AS "exporter (signal)" | table "exporter (signal)" sent failed
index="$ops_index$" sourcetype="$runtime_sourcetype$" (level=ERROR OR level=WARN) | table _time level target subscription grpc_code failure_cause err | head 200
index="$ops_index$" sourcetype="$runtime_sourcetype$" | eval message=coalesce(msg, _raw) | table _time level message target subscription | head 300
